conclusions: The reported 'harsh and centered' character of the latest v9 prime is most parsimoniously explained by mundane, non-learned causes acting together, not by a single learned 'harshness' mechanism: (a) prime selection is a within-run outlier picker with no width/harshness term, (b) the prime is a 60 s window from a run whose minutes 5-6 are near-mono (corr 0.990-0.992, side/mid ~ -23 dB), and (c) the audible path ends in tanh saturation plus whole-file peak normalization, so a center-heavy, high-mid-heavy interval is both selected and then level-raised.

Center collapse is best read as a selection + geometry artifact, not proof of a learned mono attractor: the full 600 s file is not uniformly centered (corr 0.740-0.992), so the prime's 0.991 is a window property. The training trace (median output corr 0.963 vs target 0.862; width 0.027; pan 0.0999 at the +0.10 rail) is consistent with a run that is narrower than its targets, but the trace is a within-run diagnostic, not a matched-arm result.

Harshness is not established by any supplied metric. ultrasonic_ratio is explicitly a pre-master foldback guardrail, not a brightness/harshness score (METRICS.md:94-95). The 2-6 kHz and 6-20 kHz columns are mid-channel FFT fractions, so they move with the denominator and with stereo changes (context_packet.md:55-56). No perceptual rating exists (context_packet.md:58-60).

The 'prompt caused it' reading is unsupported: suno_priming_prompt*.txt is written after rendering and prime extraction (main.rs:8682-8697; context_packet.md:19-21). The prompt's words 'focused center image' / 'bright glassy upper spectrum' are post-hoc descriptions, not causes.

The 'diffusion/smoothing will fix it' leap is unsupported. Image smoothing reduced state high-frequency energy without establishing better output (context_packet.md:61-63; deepseek_packet.md:48-51). Offline waveform filtering tests signal processing, not latent-field diffusion (context_packet.md:64-67).

The strongest single mundane artifact candidate is the interaction of (i) prime selection maximizing a score with no width/harshness term (main.rs:8141-8145, 8463-8479) and (ii) post-render tanh + peak normalization (main.rs:8059-8076, 8451). This can make a center-heavy, high-mid interval sound both centered and harsh without any change in learned behavior.
evidence: Prime selection uses only field_entropy, activity_health, structured_complexity, stagnation (main.rs:8141-8145) and picks the max-sum 60 s window (main.rs:8463-8479). No width, correlation, or harshness term. Selection can amplify a within-run outlier (context_packet.md:51-53).

Latest prime metrics: corr 0.991, side/mid -23.31 dB, 2-6 kHz 47.3%, 6-20 kHz 6.2%, 20-200 Hz 2.1% (deepseek_packet.md:24-29). Full 600 s is not uniformly centered: corr 0.740-0.992; minutes 5-6 are 0.990-0.992 with side/mid ~ -23 dB (deepseek_packet.md:31-35).

Training trace: median output corr 0.963 vs target 0.862; median truthful width 0.027; decoder width control 0.120; width raw -0.946; global pan 0.0999 at +0.10 limit; decoder side control 1.0 (deepseek_packet.md:37-41).

Stereo controls: side derives from L-R before a delayed scaled side stage; learned width bounded 0.05..0.50; global pan +/-0.10; pan-center loss penalizes bounded pan, does not reward corr=1 (context_packet.md:44-47; stereo.rs:3-7, 21-26). Increasing side gain cannot synthesize missing side information (context_packet.md:47).

Post path: loss-visible tanh, later gain/saturation/DC blocker, whole-file peak normalization (context_packet.md:48-50; main.rs:8059-8076, 8451). A sample peak below 0 dBFS does not exclude nonlinear saturation or perceptual harshness (context_packet.md:50).

Metrics caveats: ultrasonic_ratio is a foldback guardrail, not brightness (METRICS.md:94-95); spectral fractions are mid-channel FFT fractions and can reflect denominator or stereo changes (context_packet.md:55-56); side_energy_width can be high for panned mono and is not true width (METRICS.md:129-134).
Prompt is post-render output: written after rendering and prime extraction (main.rs:8682-8697; context_packet.md:19-21).
Forward has no text prompt, target audio, prime, or external reference argument (context_packet.md:13-15; AUDIO_SCIENTIFIC_INSTRUMENTATION_PLAN.md:101-108).

Historical boundary: Image smoothing reduced state high-frequency energy without establishing better output/recovery; renderer proposal docs are unimplemented (context_packet.md:61-63). Offline waveform filtering is not a proxy for latent-field diffusion (context_packet.md:64-67).

Missing evidence: perceptual ratings, independent training replicas, pre-side-scale renderer taps, frequency-specific loss gradients, detailed target mix attribution, downstream priming outcomes (context_packet.md:71-74).
